page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the left margin: a "NB." mark beside lines 6–7 and the note "Caloris innati effectus & vires." beside lines 21–24. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.p: interiora refugit, ob quod coctiones, sanguificatio-nes & nutritiones magis procedunt, tempore vere estiuo idem calidum a sibi affini videlicet exterio-ri ad extimas corporis partes evocatur, dissolu-tur atq; dissipatur, unde natura opera magis langue-scunt astate quàm hieme. Cum enim calor innatus sit NB.omnium naturalium operationum causa, sequi-tur, ubi is plurimus est & superabundat, cibi ap-petentiam intendi, coctiones, melius procedere & felicius absolui.

Et vero plurimum eum est, hiberne tempore validiorem, indicio sunt naturae operafortiora; ac tiones enim augentur, plus generatur sanguinis, corpus efficitur crassius, super fluitates, in so-nis longioribus expurgantur, & omnia melius in corpore animalis admiscentur tempore hi-berno quàm estate, quâ calor circumfusus non tan-tum inuisilia, sed etiam ea, quae secundum natu-ram in corpore continentur, una d' slusi per ec-culam diffusionem quidam calor innatus operatur. Caloris innati effectus & vires.Hinc enim beneficio non tantum alimen-tum conficitur, singuliq; partibus proprium ag-glutina ur, verum etiam omnes superfluates bu-jus excernunt, ut atq; extenuat ur, quaedam ex-quisi e per cutem, quae vero in vapores converti-ut per expirationem, sufficientem vero habentem crassi udinem per urinas, in quibus etiam plus fe-dimentiest quàm per efatem, propterea quod ca-Ratio felicius pr ficitur, corpora se undum carnem plus argentum plus etiam boni sanguinis cumulat-[?]

page.notes: Heavy damage and show-through on the lower lines (about lines 28–31, the bottom right of the text block); the readings there are doubtful and marked [?]. The first word of the page is "interiora" (lowercase, a fragment carried over from the previous page). The marginal "NB." and the side note are in the left margin. Printed spelling kept as read, e.g. "si" forms, "sanguificatio-nes", "fectus" after the hyphen in the note. The final word of the scan, at the bottom right, is illegible.
